universe_note: Expanded V1 universe for cross-sectional market-flow and investigation picks. Rankings are within this configured universe, not the full Vietnam market.

methodology.rank_current: cross-sectional rank inside the configured V1 watchlist only
methodology.rank_delta: rank 5 sessions ago minus current rank; positive means improving
methodology.participation: 5-session average volume / 20-session average volume; volume proxy, not proof of cash transfer

selection_method.leader: Top 3 relative-strength names inside each configured economic peer group.
selection_method.abnormal: Two non-leaders with the largest absolute five-session rank change; participation and relative strength break ties.
selection_method.purpose: Attention allocation only; not a buy/sell recommendation or investment score.
